## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` all pass
- [ ] `npm run format` has been run
- [ ] Tests cover the change (required for payload, validation or contrast logic)
- [ ] No new network request touches anything the user typed
- [ ] Any new colour clears WCAG AA against `surface` and `canvas` in both themes
- [ ] Checked at a narrow viewport (320px) as well as desktop

## If this touches encoding

- [ ] I scanned a generated code with at least two different phones
